definitions.explanation: The act of moving a business, residence, or organization to a different location.
The legal transfer of ownership, rights, or title from one party to another.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}が{新|あたら}しいビルに{移転|いてん}した。
examples.english: The company relocated to a new building.

examples.japanese: {所有権|しょゆうけん}の{移転|いてん}{手続|てつづ}きをする。
examples.english: To complete the transfer of ownership procedures.

examples.japanese: {移転|いてん}{先|さき}の{住所|じゅうしょ}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me the address of the new location.

notes:
USAGE: Used for official or formal relocation of businesses, organizations, or legal transfers.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{移転|いてん}{先|さき} (new location/destination)
・{移転|いてん}{届|とどけ} (notice of relocation)
・{所有権|しょゆうけん}{移転|いてん} (transfer of ownership)
・{本社|ほんしゃ}{移転|いてん} (headquarters relocation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し (moving - usually for personal/household moves)
・{移動|いどう} (movement - more general)
・{移住|いじゅう} (migration - for people changing residence)

NOTE: {移転|いてん} is more formal and often used for businesses and legal contexts.
